text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after watching a mock race with 
Biwa Hayahide, the Trainer is left stunned 
by Narita Brian's tremendous late surge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the surprise on her Trainer's face, 
Biwa Hayahide saw a reflection of her 
younger self—shocked by her sister's 
strength, panicked... and pushing herself 
to the point of injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her fellow classmates and rivals, Winning 
Ticket and Narita Taishin, showed up 
before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the two are entering the Junior 
GⅠ Hopeful Stakes. Formidable rivals she 
will one day compete against aren't 
limited to just her sister, it appears.
